description: This file contains unit test cases for the UniqueLangString class/functionality in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the uniqueness constraints for language strings and their unit IDs within the i18n language strings data, ensuring no duplicates exist.

classes.name: UniqueLangStringTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the uniqueness constraints of language strings and their unit IDs in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testUniqueValue
methods.description: Tests that language string values are unique by querying the database for duplicate values and throwing an Exception if duplicates are found.

methods.name: testUniqueUnitId
methods.description: Tests that language string unit IDs are unique, excluding specific exempted IDs, by querying the database and raising an Exception if duplicates are detected.
